title: Fix: state diagram default direction update
body:

author: omkarht

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.label_reasoning: The suggestion refactors variable naming/shadowing by renaming the parameter to avoid conflict with outer scope variable.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: A direct code suggestion to change the implementation of a find call.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Please add a unit test to verify this.
comments.label_reasoning: Requesting addition of unit tests to verify the new behavior — this is about ensuring proper test coverage/documentation of functionality.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests adding a unit test — a concrete missing artifact.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.label_reasoning: The comment requests introducing a named constant (STMT_DIR) consistent with existing constants, replacing a magic string literal to improve maintainability and consistency.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests adding a new constant STMT_DIR and using it in place of a string literal.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Please remove this.direction, as it's not used. 
Use constant `DEFAULT_DIAGRAM_DIRECTION` instead of 'TB'. 
You can change the value now.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment asks to remove `this.direction` as it is unused, and to replace a magic string 'TB' with the named constant `DEFAULT_DIAGRAM_DIRECTION`.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests removing unused field, using a named constant instead of a magic string, and potentially changing the constant's value.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: nit: This can be made a private function `getDirectionStatement`, as it's repeated below.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment identifies duplicated logic that should be extracted into a private function `getDirectionStatement` to avoid repetition.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests refactoring a repeated block into a private function with a specific name.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Changeset can be brief, if someone wants to get details, the PR will be linked in changelog. 

```suggestion
fix: `getDirection` and `setDirection` in `stateDb` refactored to return and set actual direction
```
comments.label_reasoning: The suggestion is about improving the changeset/changelog entry wording — a documentation style concern.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides a specific suggested replacement for the changeset description text.
